detaileddescription.para: Prevents unbounded growth of LLM prompt context. Typical retrieval context is < 100 KiB.

detaileddescription.para: Prevents infinite loops in linked process hierarchies.

xrefdescription.para: P23-03: Verify properties map access is bounds-safe

detaileddescription.para: Tests that accessing att_node.properties["collection"] (line 244-245) is properly handled without bounds violations. The KGNode properties map should handle dynamic key creation safely.

xrefdescription.para: P23-04: Verify concurrent loads don't cause data races

detaileddescription.para: Tests that multiple threads can safely call loadFromJson/loadFromXml without causing data races. The fix adds mutex protection to tables_.

xrefdescription.para: P23-05: Verify concurrent evaluation and load calls are safe

detaileddescription.para: Tests that evaluate() and loadFromJson() can be called concurrently without causing data races. The mutex protects both read and write access.

xrefdescription.para: P23-06: Verify YAML list import has proper resource management

detaileddescription.para: Tests that importYamlList() properly manages string/vector allocations and doesn't leak resources even when exceptions occur. All allocations use RAII (std::string, std::vector).

xrefdescription.para: P23-06 Extended: Verify exception safety in YAML parsing

detaileddescription.para: Tests that even with large/malformed YAML, resources are properly cleaned up and no leaks occur. All string and vector allocations are RAII-managed.
